title: Celecoxib Japan Observational Study for the Patients With Acute Pain
brief_summary: This study is to assess the safety and efficacy of celecoxib on the pain relief from acute pain.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with traumatic pain, post-surgical pain and tooth extract pain

Exclusion Criteria:

* Hyperreactive to sulfonamide
* Aspirin asthma patients
* Peptidic ulcer patients
* Serious liver disease patients
* Serious kidney disease patients
* Serious heart failure patients
* End of pregnancy
study_population: Patients with traumatic pain, post-surgical pain and tooth extract pain
condition: Patients With Traumatic Pain, Post-surgical Pain and Tooth Extract Pain
